profile.summary: Puffin-D is a deep learning model that predicts transcription initiation signals from DNA sequence. It takes 100 kbp of genome sequence and returns base-level predictions for ten tracks: five assays that map transcription start sites (FANTOM CAGE, ENCODE CAGE, ENCODE RAMPAGE, GRO-cap and PRO-cap) on each strand. It is the prediction-focused companion of Puffin, an interpretable model from the same authors.

summary_quotes.text: Puffin-D is a deep learning model that predicts tanscription inititation signal for 100Kbp genome sequence.
FANTOM_CAGE (forward strand), ENCODE_CAGE (forward strand), ENCODE_RAMPAGE (forward strand), GRO_CAP (forward strand), PRO_CAP (forward strand), PRO_CAP (reverse strand)
For the prediction-focused deep learning model Puffin-D

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Puffin-D is a fully convolutional network. One-hot DNA passes through a stack of strided 1D convolutions that downsample the sequence by factors of 4, 4, 5, 5, 5 and 2, each followed by residual convolution blocks. Upsampling layers with skip connections then restore base resolution. This down-and-up pass is repeated a second time. A final 1x1 convolution with a softplus gives 10 non-negative output tracks at each position. Training details were not in the sources read.

sections.title: Puffin and Puffin-D
sections.body: The repository holds two models. Puffin is an interpretation-focused model that explains each transcription start site in terms of motifs and single bases, and works on short sequences with 325 bp padding on each side. Puffin-D is the deep learning model for prediction over 100 kbp. The README says Puffin-D gives better predictions when prediction is the main need.
sections.source_locator: README.md: introduction; Command line interface (CLI) Usage

quotes.text: Puffin is an interpretation-focused sequence model for transcription initiation in the human genome which is also applicable to other mammalian species.
The model needs 325bp padding on both side of the sequence
Puffin-D offers better predictions of signals if prediction is your primary need.

sections.title: Versions and reproducibility
sections.body: One Puffin-D weights file is published, puffin_D.pth in Zenodo record 7941729 (dated 2023-05-15, md5 c1a68222fda4c17b1c0c0864f658460e). The paper is a bioRxiv preprint later published in Science (DOI 10.1126/science.adj0116). Training code is in a separate manuscript repository, jzhoulab/puffin_manuscript, which was not read. A result should name the Zenodo record and the code commit; this page read the code at commit 9bc81eb9.

facts.label: Model type
facts.value: Supervised deep learning sequence model that predicts base-resolution transcription initiation signal from DNA sequence.

quotes.text: Puffin-D is a deep learning model that predicts tanscription inititation signal for 100Kbp genome sequence.

facts.label: Architecture
facts.value: Fully convolutional encoder-decoder (U-Net-like) with residual convolution blocks and skip connections, applied in two down-and-up passes; 10 softplus output channels.

facts.label: Inputs
facts.value: A 100,000 bp DNA sequence, given as an hg38 coordinate (centre position and strand), a region file or a FASTA file; the script rejects other lengths.

quotes.text: Directly specifying a genome region in the format of chr:sequence center position*strand* with no space (e.g. chr7:5530600-)

facts.label: Outputs
facts.value: A NumPy array of predicted transcription initiation signal for 10 targets: FANTOM CAGE, ENCODE CAGE, ENCODE RAMPAGE, GRO-cap and PRO-cap, each on the forward and reverse strand.

quotes.text: Command line interface outputs a numpy array with prediciton for each target in following order: FANTOM_CAGE (forward strand), ENCODE_CAGE (forward strand), ENCODE_RAMPAGE (forward strand), GRO_CAP (forward strand), PRO_CAP (forward strand), PRO_CAP (reverse strand), GRO_CAP (reverse strand), ENCODE_RAMPAGE (reverse strand), ENCODE_CAGE (reverse strand), FANTOM_CAGE (reverse strand).

facts.label: Parameters
facts.value: Not extracted. The parameter count is not stated in the sources read; the full paper could not be fetched.

run_guide.summary: Install the Puffin repository at a pinned commit, download hg38 and the Puffin-D weights, and predict transcription initiation for the 100 kbp window around one hg38 position.
prerequisites: Python 3.6 or later, as the README recommends; dependencies numpy, pandas, torch, docopt, selene_sdk and torch_fftconv.
The hg38 genome FASTA (downloaded in step 3) and the puffin_D.pth weights from Zenodo.
Runs on CPU by default; --use_cuda needs a CUDA GPU. Memory needs are not stated.
Code is for academic research use only.

steps.title: Get the code at the pinned commit
steps.shell:
git clone https://github.com/jzhoulab/puffin.git
cd puffin
git checkout --detach 9bc81eb922f44556879d1d2afd4c757a1d6c291e
steps.explanation: The clone and cd lines are from the README; the checkout line is added to get the commit this page was written from.

steps.title: Install dependencies
steps.explanation: Installs the Python dependencies. For GPU use, the README says to install PyTorch 1.7.0 or later following the PyTorch instructions.

steps.title: Download the hg38 genome
steps.shell:
wget https://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/hg38/bigZips/hg38.fa.gz
mv  hg38.fa.gz ./resources
cd ./resources
gzip -d hg38.fa.gz
cd ../
steps.explanation: Places hg38.fa in resources/, where puffin_D.py reads it. The first run builds an index, which takes a few minutes.
steps.source_locator: README.md: Download model and relevant resource files; puffin_D.py

steps.explanation: Places the weights in resources/, where the model class loads them.

steps.title: Predict for one position
steps.explanation: Predicts the 100 kbp window centred on chr7:5530600 on the minus strand. Add --use_cuda to run on a GPU.
